map.反应自测：目标出现后尽快点击，测视觉-运动反应时。: Reaction drill: click as fast as you can once the target appears, to measure visual-motor reaction time.
map.手眼协调：连续测多次看稳定性。: Hand-eye coordination: take several consecutive measurements to see the stability.
map.趣味挑战：记录平均与最佳成绩。: Fun challenge: record your average and your best score.
